# Nominations Open for Window Fashion VISION’s 2026 40 Under 40

Seeking nominations for emerging leaders, innovators and rising talent representing the next generation of the window covering industry.

[**Lindsay Brown**](https://www.wf-vision.com/profile/lbrown/)// September 3, 2026

- [![twitter](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/x-logo+black.svg)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Nominations+Open+for+Window+Fashion+VISION%E2%80%99s+2026+40+Under+40&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Findustry-news%2Fnominations-open-for-window-fashion-visions-2026-40-under-40%2F)

_Window Fashion VISION_ is now accepting nominations for its 2026 [40 Under 40](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/40-under-40/ "Posts tagged with 40 Under 40") Awards, recognizing outstanding professionals ages 18–39 who are making a meaningful impact on the window covering industry. Since its launch in 2020, the _Window Fashion VISION_ 40 Under 40 Awards have celebrated rising professionals whose leadership, innovation, accomplishments and commitment are helping advance the industry and shape its future.

“The window covering industry is filled with incredible emerging talent across every area of the profession,” said Lindsay Brown, Managing Editor, _Window Fashion VISION_. “From design and fabrication to installation, automation, sales, marketing and manufacturing, these professionals are bringing new ideas, energy and leadership to our industry. The 40 Under 40 Awards give us an opportunity to recognize their accomplishments and celebrate the people who are helping move our industry forward.”

**Who Should Be Nominated?**

_Window Fashion VISION_ is seeking outstanding professionals ages 18–39 who are making a meaningful impact on the window covering industry. Nominees may come from across all areas of the industry, including:

- Workroom and fabrication professionals
- Interior designers who regularly specify custom window treatments
- Installers, integrators and automation professionals
- Retail, dealer and manufacturing professionals
- Sales and business development professionals
- Marketing, social media and communications professionals
- Operations, HR and other industry professionals
- Anyone actively contributing to and helping shape the future of the window covering industry

If they’re making an impact, advancing the industry or demonstrating exceptional potential, Window Fashion VISION wants to hear about them. Industry professionals are encouraged to nominate deserving colleagues, employees, partners and peers. Nominations should highlight the nominee’s accomplishments, contributions to the industry and the qualities that distinguish them as an emerging leader.

**Please note: Past _Window Fashion VISION_ 40 Under 40 honorees are not eligible to win again.**

**Submit an Honoree** Know someone who deserves to be recognized among the window covering industry’s next generation of leaders? Submit them for consideration for the 2026 _Window Fashion VISION_ 40 Under 40 Awards.

Nominations are open now through Wednesday, September 30, 2026.

**Submit an Honoree [here](https://form.jotform.com/262354640965160).**

**About Window Fashion VISION** _Window Fashion VISION_ is a leading trade publication serving the custom window covering industry, delivering industry news, trends, business insights, product innovation and educational content to professionals throughout the window treatment and [interior design](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/interior-design/ "Posts tagged with interior design") communities. _Window Fashion VISION_ is affiliated with the International Window Coverings Expo (IWCE), the premier trade event dedicated to the window covering industry.

# Sombra Shades Launches Industry-First Native PoE Drapery Motor

[**Lindsay Brown**](https://www.wf-vision.com/profile/lbrown/)// September 3, 2026

- [![twitter](https://www.wf-vision.com/wp-content/themes/homefurnishingnews/images/x-logo+black.svg)](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=Sombra+Shades+Launches+Industry-First+Native+PoE+Drapery+Motor&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.wf-vision.com%2Fmotorization%2Fsombra-shades-launches-industry-first-native-poe-drapery-motor%2F)

[Sombra Shades](https://www.sombrashades.com/), the leader in luxury-grade [motorized shade solutions](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/motorized-shade-solutions/ "Posts tagged with motorized shade solutions"), today announced the launch of its [Native Power over Ethernet (PoE) Drapery Motor](https://www.sombrashades.com/pages/poe-drapery), a first-of-its-kind solution designed to bring direct PoE operation to motorized drapery. The new motor expands [Sombra Shades](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/sombra-shades/ "Posts tagged with Sombra Shades")‘ broader offering of PoE roller shade motors and shade applications, giving dealers, fabricators and [integration](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/integration/ "Posts tagged with integration") professionals a path to deliver unified, [luxury-grade window-covering](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/luxury-grade-window-covering/ "Posts tagged with luxury-grade window-covering") systems.

This motor was developed to address a gap in the motorized drapery market. Traditionally, installers had to choose between battery-operated systems and hardwired systems that require separate wires for power and data and add installation complexity. The Sombra Native [PoE Drapery Motor](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/poe-drapery-motor/ "Posts tagged with PoE drapery motor") uses Power over Ethernet to combine power and network connectivity through a single low-voltage cable, supporting a cleaner installation while eliminating batteries.

Sombra’s design features a local RF remote control allowing the motor to be operated and programmed directly through its RF remote. This provides responsive everyday control and a practical local-control option independent of a network connection. Additionally, integrators can use its local IP control interface and JSON-based API to integrate the motor with leading third-party control systems, including [Control4](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/control4/ "Posts tagged with Control4") and [Crestron Home](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/crestron-home/ "Posts tagged with Crestron Home"). In partnership with integration companies, Sombra Shades plans to expand to operators.

Key features include:

– Simplified installation: One Ethernet cable delivers both power and connectivity, helping reduce wiring clutter.

– [Battery-free operation](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/battery-free-operation/ "Posts tagged with battery-free operation"): Direct PoE eliminates battery charging cycles, battery replacement and related service demands.

– Local-control reliability: Direct RF remote control and programming provide a responsive local-control option independent of a network connection.

Integration flexibility: A local JSON API supports integration with leading third-party automation platforms.

– Cleaner long-term ownership: The absence of an onboard power buffer removes a component category that can age, lose capacity and eventually require service.

– A complete PoE full offering: The drapery motor complements Sombra Shades’ roller shade motors and broader motorized shade portfolio.

“Drapery was the missing piece of a complete PoE offering,” said Rick Rizner, CTO and Managing Partner at Sombra Shades. “With this motor, we’re giving dealers and integrators a refined solution that brings dual-protocol control together in one product: simple local RF control and programming, along with straightforward integration into the leading control systems their clients already love. It gives them the flexibility of advanced automation without requiring complex software to configure or enjoy it.”

Unlike motor designs that use onboard power reserves, Sombra’s Native PoE Drapery Motor is designed to operate directly from PoE infrastructure without an onboard battery or power buffer. This approach removes a potential long-term maintenance and replacement consideration while providing predictable power from the installed Ethernet network whenever the system is energized.

For dealers and installers, the direct-PoE architecture can simplify troubleshooting by focusing diagnostics on familiar infrastructure components, including the Ethernet run, PoE switch or injector, network connection and motor.

“Dealers want to offer a PoE shading solution without creating extra steps between the shade installer and the integration team,” said Chris Taylor, Executive Sales Officer and General Manager at Sombra Shades. “This motor gives dealers a direct path from installation and setup to control-system integration. The result is a more seamless project experience and a polished, fully integrated luxury solution clients can see and enjoy every day.”

Sombra Shades, the leader in luxury-grade motorized shade solutions, today announced the launch of its Native Power over Ethernet (PoE) Drapery Motor, a first-of-its-kind solution designed to bring direct PoE operation to motorized drapery. The new motor expands Sombra Shades' broader offering of PoE roller shade motors and shade applications, giving dealers, fabricators, and integration professionals a path to deliver unified, luxury-grade window-covering systems.

This motor was developed to address a gap in the motorized drapery market. Traditionally, installers had to choose between battery-operated systems and hardwired systems that require separate wires for power and data and add installation complexity. The Sombra Native PoE Drapery Motor uses Power over Ethernet to combine power and network connectivity through a single low-voltage cable, supporting a cleaner installation while eliminating batteries.

Sombra’s design features a local RF remote control allowing the motor to be operated and programmed directly through its RF remote. This provides responsive everyday control and a practical local-control option independent of a network connection. Additionally, integrators can use its local IP control interface and JSON-based API to integrate the motor with leading third-party control systems, including Control4 and Crestron Home. In partnership with integration companies, Sombra Shades plans to expand to operators.

Key features include:

- Simplified installation: One Ethernet cable delivers both power and connectivity, helping reduce wiring clutter.
- Battery-free operation: Direct PoE eliminates battery charging cycles, battery replacement and related service demands.
- Local-control reliability: Direct RF remote control and programming provide a responsive local-control option independent of a network connection.
- Integration flexibility: A local JSON API supports integration with leading third-party automation platforms.
- Cleaner long-term ownership: The absence of an onboard power buffer removes a component category that can age, lose capacity and eventually require service.
- A complete PoE full offering: The drapery motor complements Sombra Shades’ roller shade motors and broader motorized shade portfolio.

“Drapery was the missing piece of a complete PoE offering,” said Rick Rizner, CTO and Managing Partner at Sombra Shades. “With this motor, we’re giving dealers and integrators a refined solution that brings dual-protocol control together in one product: simple local RF control and programming, along with straightforward integration into the leading control systems their clients already love. It gives them the flexibility of advanced automation without requiring complex software to configure or enjoy it.”

Unlike motor designs that use onboard power reserves, Sombra’s Native PoE Drapery Motor is designed to operate directly from PoE infrastructure without an onboard battery or power buffer. This approach removes a potential long-term maintenance and replacement consideration while providing predictable power from the installed Ethernet network whenever the system is energized.

For dealers and installers, the direct-PoE architecture can simplify troubleshooting by focusing diagnostics on familiar infrastructure components, including the Ethernet run, PoE switch or injector, network connection and motor.

“Dealers want to offer a PoE shading solution without creating extra steps between the shade installer and the integration team,” said Chris Taylor, Executive Sales Officer and General Manager at Sombra Shades. “This motor gives dealers a direct path from installation and setup to control-system integration. The result is a more seamless project experience and a polished, fully integrated luxury solution clients can see and enjoy every day.

[Carole Fabrics](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/carole-fabrics/ "Posts tagged with Carole Fabrics") has introduced its [Fall](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/fall/ "Posts tagged with fall") 2026 Decorative [Fabric Collection](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/fabric-collection/ "Posts tagged with Fabric Collection"), featuring more than 560 new fabrics spanning heritage-inspired patterns, linen-like textures, colorful prints, embroideries and sheers.

**Archival Influences** features heritage-inspired jacquard wovens with botanical motifs and transitional styling, while **Soft Surroundings** offers drapable solids and textures in a soft, tonal palette.

Four color-focused collections bring prints and embroideries into the mix: **Blue Horizons** explores shades from light sky to deep midnight; **Verdant Vision** ranges from subtle to vibrant greens; **Natural Harmony** features earthy sand-to-sable tones; and **Sunlit Serenity** combines warm golds, oranges and reds with hints of blue.

Rounding out the collection, **La Petite** features small-scale stripes, botanicals, florals and coral patterns, while **Ethereal Elegance** offers narrow sheers with linen-inspired textures, detailed embroideries and colored prints.

Each grouping includes Carole Exclusives, offering designers fresh options for fall projects. To view the collections, explore the Fall 2026 [Inspiration](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/inspiration/ "Posts tagged with Inspiration") Book or order hard-copy sample books, visit [CaroleFabrics.com](https://www.carolefabrics.com/fabric/design-essentials/?utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=likeshopme&utm_content).

The Educational Foundation of the [International Furnishings and Design Association](https://www.ifda.com/educational-foundation/)( [IFDA](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/ifda/ "Posts tagged with IFDA")) has announced its 2026 grant recipients, awarding $38,500 to support professional development, research and educational initiatives across the design industry.

This year’s funded projects span universal design, historic preservation, color and lighting education, healthcare design and professional development.

“We’re honored to support the inspiring range of projects through this year’s grants,” said Karen Dzendolet, chairman of the board of the Educational Foundation of IFDA. “All the initiatives demonstrate considerable talent and skill and a willingness to take on new challenges.”

**The 2026 grant recipients are:**

- **Irma Dobkin Universal Design Grant ($2,000):** Soheil Jafari, PhD student in design and merchandising at Oklahoma State University
- **Ina Mae Kaplan Historic Preservation Grant ($2,000):** Lisa M. Tucker, PhD, professor at Virginia Tech and director of the Center for Historic Preservation in the School of Design
- **Elizabeth Brown Grant to [Interior Design](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/interior-design/ "Posts tagged with interior design") Programs ($2,500):** Nam-Kyu Park, chair of the Department of Interior Design at the University of Florida
- **Tony Torrice Professional Development Grant ($1,500):** Hamed Yekita, PhD, assistant professor of interior design at Iowa State University
- **Valerie Moran Memorial Grant (up to $3,000):** Jennifer Driscoll, founder of Broadview Marketing and Broadview Tours

“The selection process is challenging with such talented applicants,” said Earline Feldman, FIFDA, director of scholarships and grants. “Each recipient stood out for their vision, dedication and potential to make a meaningful contribution to the field; we are delighted to recognize their achievements.”

[IFDA Educational Foundation](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/ifda-educational-foundation/ "Posts tagged with IFDA Educational Foundation") grants are available to professionals working in interior design and furnishings-related fields. The foundation also provides scholarships for undergraduate and graduate students and funding to support IFDA chapter programming.

For more information, visit [IFDAEF.org](http://ifdaef.org/).

[Behr](http://www.behr.com/) has named Grounded (T27-01), an earthy olive green inspired by nature, its 2027 [Color of the Year](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/color-of-the-year/ "Posts tagged with color of the year").

Blending moss and olive tones with subtle brown undertones, Grounded taps into the continued desire for interiors that feel warm, restorative and connected to the natural world. The versatile shade is designed to bring a sense of calm to a space while still offering enough depth to make an impact.

“Grounded is a reminder that the most meaningful spaces are the ones that help us connect with the rhythms of everyday life,” said Kayla Kratz, head of color at [Behr](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/behr/ "Posts tagged with behr") [Paint](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/paint/ "Posts tagged with paint") Company. “The shade’s organic warmth creates a sense of calm and renewal, making every room feel inviting and effortlessly livable.”

Grounded anchors Behr’s [2027 Color Trends Palette](https://www.behr.com/colors/color-detail/t27-01), a collection inspired by the beauty and balance of the natural world. The palette spans warm neutrals, earthy tones, muted pinks, clay hues and airy blues, offering plenty of opportunities for layering color throughout the home.

The collection also brings seven Behr legacy colors back into the mix: Coastal Beige, Wheat Grass, Environmental, Denim Light, Smokey Claret, Sarsaparilla and Mozart. Each was selected to complement Grounded and help create cohesive, nature-inspired palettes.

The selection comes as homeowners increasingly look to their interiors as a place to retreat and recharge. According to research conducted by Behr, 86% of Americans say home DIY and design projects help them feel grounded by allowing them to create a safe, comforting haven, while 84% say the right paint color is critical to making a space feel like home.

This year’s announcement also marks the 10th anniversary of Behr’s Color of the Year program, which has evolved over the past decade alongside changing attitudes toward color, design and the role the home plays in everyday life.

To commemorate the milestone, Behr is donating $250,000 to Habitat for Humanity to support affordable homeownership programs and help families create comfortable, stable homes.

Grounded and the complete Behr 2027 Color Trends Palette are available in Behr Dynasty, Behr Marquee, Behr Ultra and Behr Premium Plus paints through The Home Depot.

Behr has named Grounded (T27-01), an earthy olive green inspired by nature, its 2027 Color of the Year.  
Blending moss and olive tones with subtle brown undertones, Grounded taps into the continued desire for interiors that feel warm, restorative and connected to the natural world. The versatile shade is designed to bring a sense of calm to a space while still offering enough depth to make an impact.  
“Grounded is a reminder that the most meaningful spaces are the ones that help us connect with the rhythms of everyday life,” said Kayla Kratz, head of color at Behr Paint Company. “The shade’s organic warmth creates a sense of calm and renewal, making every room feel inviting and effortlessly livable.”  
Grounded anchors Behr’s 2027 Color Trends Palette, a collection inspired by the beauty and balance of the natural world. The palette spans warm neutrals, earthy tones, muted pinks, clay hues and airy blues, offering plenty of opportunities for layering color throughout the home.  
The collection also brings seven Behr legacy colors back into the mix: Coastal Beige, Wheat Grass, Environmental, Denim Light, Smokey Claret, Sarsaparilla and Mozart. Each was selected to complement Grounded and help create cohesive, nature-inspired palettes.  
The selection comes as homeowners increasingly look to their interiors as a place to retreat and recharge. According to research conducted by Behr, 86% of Americans say home DIY and design projects help them feel grounded by allowing them to create a safe, comforting haven, while 84% say the right paint color is critical to making a space feel like home.  
This year’s announcement also marks the 10th anniversary of Behr’s Color of the Year program, which has evolved over the past decade alongside changing attitudes toward color, design and the role the home plays in everyday life.  
To commemorate the milestone, Behr is donating $250,000 to Habitat for Humanity to support affordable homeownership programs and help families create comfortable, stable homes.  
Grounded and the complete Behr 2027 Color Trends Palette are available in Behr Dynasty, Behr Marquee, Behr Ultra and Behr Premium Plus paints through The Home Depot.

Award-winning custom window coverings designer and industry educator [Deb Barrett](http://debbarrett.com/) today announced that enrollment is now open for the [Fall](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/fall/ "Posts tagged with fall") session of her [Window Treatment Certification Course](http://debbarrett.com/w-t-certification.), beginning October 7, 2026. As an added incentive, every student who registers will receive a free 1-hour virtual Strategy Session, a one-on-one consultation designed to help them put the skills learned in the course directly to work in their own design business.

The highly popular Window Treatment Certification Course is a comprehensive, 12-week program built for interior designers, decorators, and design professionals who want to master the art and science of custom window coverings. Delivered through weekly live webinar sessions plus hands-on exercises and mentoring, the course covers the full scope of window treatment design and specification — from measuring, drapery hardware, and fabric and lining selection, to fullness calculations, pattern placement, couture fabrication techniques, and client presentation. Graduates earn the distinction of Certified [Window Treatment Specialist](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/window-treatment-specialist/ "Posts tagged with window treatment specialist") (CWTS), a credential they can use to market themselves as verified experts in a notoriously complex and underserved design category.

“Window treatments are one of the most complex — and most commonly mishandled — parts of a design project,” said Barrett. “I built this course to hand designers the tools, vocabulary, and confidence to get it right every time. Adding a free Strategy Session for this Fall’s students takes it a step further — it’s dedicated, one-on-one time to map out exactly how they’ll apply what they’ve learned to their own business, right away.”

**What Graduates Are Saying**

_“This was one of the most comprehensive and thorough courses I’ve ever taken. — I’m going to recommend this course to someone I know that’s interested in expanding their window covering offerings.”_

_“This course was so much more than I ever expected… I’ve told all my colleagues how valuable it has been and I highly recommend they invest in this opportunity.”_

_“The course is the best on the market, and I strongly recommend all designers and window treatment professionals take it. It helped me get the confidence and knowledge I need to be successful in my business.”_

Designers, decorators, and design industry professionals interested in registering for the Fall session can find full details at [debbarrett.com/w-t-certification](https://debbarrett.com/w-t-certification/).

**About [Deb Barrett](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/deb-barrett/ "Posts tagged with Deb Barrett")**

Deb Barrett is an award-winning custom window coverings designer, industry educator, and sought-after speaker with more than 30 years of experience in the design industry. As founder of Window Dressings, an award-winning couture window treatment design firm, Barrett built a reputation for solving the industry’s most challenging design problems with cutting-edge, custom treatments. She has developed training programs for some of the industry’s biggest names and now shares that expertise directly with design professionals through her Window Treatment Certification Course, webinars, and speaking engagements at industry events nationwide.

[Trivantage](http://trivantage.com/), a trusted supplier for professionals in the [furnishings](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/furnishings/ "Posts tagged with furnishings") industry, today announced the official launch of the [Sunbrella Fusion Collection](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/sunbrella-fusion-collection/ "Posts tagged with Sunbrella Fusion Collection"), exclusively distributed by the company. The curated lineup features 144 SKUs specifically designed to support the creative vision of today’s makers with trend-forward solids and patterns.

This collection represents a significant new launch in the furnishings category, blending elevated design appeal with the trusted, livable performance of Sunbrella. Professionals can specify these fabrics with confidence, as they provide the [durability](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/durability/ "Posts tagged with durability"), [stain resistance](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/stain-resistance/ "Posts tagged with stain resistance"), and easy cleanability required for high-traffic [indoor and outdoor](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/indoor-and-outdoor/ "Posts tagged with indoor and outdoor") spaces for real, everyday life.

The collection rollout begins with a series of industry events, starting with the [Fall Casual Market](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/fall-casual-market/ "Posts tagged with Fall Casual Market") in Atlanta from September 15-18, 2026, featuring a happy-hour launch party. [Trivantage](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/trivantage/ "Posts tagged with Trivantage") will also showcase the collection at the [Custom Workroom Conference](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/custom-workroom-conference/ "Posts tagged with Custom Workroom Conference") from September 28-30 and the [Advanced Textiles Expo](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/advanced-textiles-expo/ "Posts tagged with Advanced Textiles Expo") from November 3-5, showcasing sample tools and updated fabrics in the booth.

“At Trivantage, we support makers’ visions with materials that bring their ideas to life,” said Mellisa Bagwell, Furnishings Director at Trivantage. “The Sunbrella Fusion Collection was carefully curated to offer makers an unparalleled range of creative possibilities with the confidence to support customers’ everyday lives.”

These [high-performance fabrics](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/high-performance-fabrics/ "Posts tagged with high-performance fabrics") can be used in all spaces of the home and are backed by a five-year limited warranty.

To learn more about the Sunbrella Fusion Collection, visit [trivantage.com](http://trivantage.com/).

[OPTEX Screens](https://www.optexscreens.com/) has introduced [OPTEX 2.0](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/optex-2-0/ "Posts tagged with OPTEX 2.0"), a [self-assembly](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/self-assembly/ "Posts tagged with self-assembly") [exterior screen system](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/exterior-screen-system/ "Posts tagged with exterior screen system") designed to simplify the process of adding [solar protection](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/solar-protection/ "Posts tagged with solar protection"), [privacy](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/privacy/ "Posts tagged with privacy") and comfort to [residential spaces](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/residential-spaces/ "Posts tagged with residential spaces").

The customizable system helps reduce solar heat gain and glare while maintaining views to the outdoors. Designed for use on [windows](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/windows/ "Posts tagged with windows"), [patios](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/patios/ "Posts tagged with patios") and [porches](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/porches/ "Posts tagged with porches"), OPTEX 2.0 can help create cooler, more comfortable spaces while adding privacy and curb appeal.

A key feature of the new system is its self-assembly design. Rather than arriving as a fully assembled screen, OPTEX 2.0 is delivered directly to the homeowner in a compact tube with the components needed for assembly and installation. The approach is designed to simplify shipping while reducing packaging and associated costs.

Once installed, the exterior screens help block harsh sunlight before it reaches the interior, supporting greater comfort and energy efficiency without sacrificing the connection to the outdoors.

With its combination of customizable design, solar control and DIY-friendly assembly, OPTEX 2.0 offers homeowners a new option for upgrading windows and outdoor living spaces.

Visit [OptexScreens.com](https://www.optexscreens.com/) for more information.

# September’s Must-See Design Events

[**Lindsay Brown**](https://www.wf-vision.com/profile/lbrown/)// August 24, 2026

September marks one of the busiest stretches on the design calendar, with major festivals, markets and industry gatherings taking place from Paris to Las Vegas. Whether you’re looking for new products, fresh [inspiration](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/inspiration/ "Posts tagged with Inspiration") or a chance to connect with fellow design professionals, here are the events to have on your radar this coming month.

**[Paris Design Week and Maison&Objet](https://www.maison-objet.com/en/paris-design-week)** **Paris \| September 10–19**

[Paris Design Week](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/paris-design-week/ "Posts tagged with Paris Design Week") returns with 500 participants across 320 showrooms, galleries, studios, museums and other locations throughout the city. Running alongside the festival from Sept. 10–14, Maison&Objet brings 2,300 brands from 49 countries to Paris Nord Villepinte for five days of new products, emerging talent, installations and talks. This edition centers on the theme “Pulse in Motion,” with seven sectors exploring new directions in design and the decorative arts.

**[London Design Festival](https://londondesignfestival.com/)** **London \| September 12–20**

Now in its 24th edition, [London Design Festival](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/london-design-festival/ "Posts tagged with London Design Festival") brings exhibitions, installations, talks and other programming to locations throughout the city. This year’s festival includes 11 design districts along with landmark installations and special projects showcasing work across furniture, materials, craft and other design disciplines.

[**Fall Casual Market Atlanta**](https://casualmarketatlanta.com/)

**Atlanta \| September 15–18**

More than 120 permanent showrooms and temporary exhibits come together at [AmericasMart](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/americasmart/ "Posts tagged with americasmart") for the [fall](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/fall/ "Posts tagged with fall") edition of Casual Market Atlanta. Geared toward the [outdoor furnishings](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/outdoor-furnishings/ "Posts tagged with outdoor furnishings") industry, the market features furniture, performance materials and outdoor accessories along with new product introductions, educational programming and industry events. This year’s schedule includes an Outdoor Living Trends Talk and a new Luxe Design section.

[**Fall Market at AmericasMart**](https://www.americasmart.com/en/Markets/Fall-Market)

**Atlanta \| September 15–18**

Held alongside Fall Casual Market Atlanta, Fall Market opens more than 350 AmericasMart showrooms spanning home decor, tabletop, gift, stationery and other categories. The four-day market gives designers and retailers a midseason opportunity to source new products, meet with vendors and prepare for the final months of the year.

[**Kips Bay Decorator Show House New York**](https://www.kipsbaydecoratorshowhouse.org/nyplanyourvisit)

**New York \| September 16–October 13**

The Kips Bay Decorator Show House returns to New York, this year taking over a historic Greenwich Village townhouse at 80 West Washington Place. Leading interior designers will each transform a space within the home, which opens to the public Sept. 16 following an opening-night event on Sept. 15. Proceeds benefit the Kips Bay Boys & Girls Club.

[**Brussels Design Week**](https://designseptember.be/en/about)

**Brussels \| September 24–October 4**

Formerly known as Brussels Design September, [Brussels Design Week](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/brussels-design-week/ "Posts tagged with Brussels Design Week") celebrates its 20th edition with exhibitions, open studios, talks and other events at locations throughout the Belgian capital. Programming highlights established and emerging Belgian and international designers working across furniture, craft, materials and other areas of contemporary design.

[**Vienna Design Week**](https://www.viennadesignweek.at/en)

**Vienna \| September 25–October 4**

[Vienna Design Week](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/vienna-design-week/ "Posts tagged with Vienna Design Week") marks its 20th edition with exhibitions, installations, workshops, talks and tours across the Austrian capital. The curated festival explores product, furniture, graphic, social and industrial design, with programming that also examines craftsmanship and the processes behind how objects are made.

[**Interior Design Society National Conference**](https://interiordesignsociety.org/conference)

**Las Vegas \| September 28–30**

Interior designers and industry partners from around the country gather in Las Vegas for the [Interior Design](https://www.wf-vision.com/tag/interior-design/ "Posts tagged with interior design") Society’s annual conference. Held at the Bellagio with programming at the Las Vegas Design Center, the three-day event features educational sessions, speakers, showroom visits and networking opportunities geared toward residential design professionals.

September marks one of the busiest stretches on the design calendar, with major festivals, markets and industry gatherings taking place from Paris to Las Vegas. Whether you’re looking for new products, fresh inspiration or a chance to connect with fellow design professionals, here are the events to have on your radar this coming month.

Paris Design Week and Maison&Objet Paris | September 10–19

Paris Design Week returns with 500 participants across 320 showrooms, galleries, studios, museums and other locations throughout the city. Running alongside the festival from Sept. 10–14, Maison&Objet brings 2,300 brands from 49 countries to Paris Nord Villepinte for five days of new products, emerging talent, installations and talks. This edition centers on the theme “Pulse in Motion,” with seven sectors exploring new directions in design and the decorative arts.

London Design Festival London | September 12–20

Now in its 24th edition, London Design Festival brings exhibitions, installations, talks and other programming to locations throughout the city. This year’s festival includes 11 design districts along with landmark installations and special projects showcasing work across furniture, materials, craft and other design disciplines.

Fall Casual Market Atlanta Atlanta | September 15–18

More than 120 permanent showrooms and temporary exhibits come together at AmericasMart for the fall edition of Casual Market Atlanta. Geared toward the outdoor furnishings industry, the market features furniture, performance materials and outdoor accessories along with new product introductions, educational programming and industry events. This year’s schedule includes an Outdoor Living Trends Talk and a new Luxe Design section.

Fall Market at AmericasMart Atlanta | September 15–18

Held alongside Fall Casual Market Atlanta, Fall Market opens more than 350 AmericasMart showrooms spanning home decor, tabletop, gift, stationery and other categories. The four-day market gives designers and retailers a midseason opportunity to source new products, meet with vendors and prepare for the final months of the year.

Kips Bay Decorator Show House New York New York | September 16–October 13

The Kips Bay Decorator Show House returns to New York, this year taking over a historic Greenwich Village townhouse at 80 West Washington Place. Leading interior designers will each transform a space within the home, which opens to the public Sept. 16 following an opening-night event on Sept. 15. Proceeds benefit the Kips Bay Boys & Girls Club.

Brussels Design Week Brussels | September 24–October 4

Formerly known as Brussels Design September, Brussels Design Week celebrates its 20th edition with exhibitions, open studios, talks and other events at locations throughout the Belgian capital. Programming highlights established and emerging Belgian and international designers working across furniture, craft, materials and other areas of contemporary design.

Vienna Design Week Vienna | September 25–October 4

Vienna Design Week marks its 20th edition with exhibitions, installations, workshops, talks and tours across the Austrian capital. The curated festival explores product, furniture, graphic, social and industrial design, with programming that also examines craftsmanship and the processes behind how objects are made.

Interior Design Society National Conference Las Vegas | September 28–30

Interior designers and industry partners from around the country gather in Las Vegas for the Interior Design Society’s annual conference. Held at the Bellagio with programming at the Las Vegas Design Center, the three-day event features educational sessions, speakers, showroom visits and networking opportunities geared toward residential design professionals.
